name: cgtn.com
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But 4435 sitemap URLs point at another host or scheme.
lesson: Serve sitemap.xml from the same host as the pages it lists, and name it in robots.txt.
summary: www.cgtn.com scores 58 out of 100 (D). 9 checks fail now, 32 are at risk, and 27 pass. Fix first: 4435 sitemap URLs point at another host or scheme.

fix.title: 4435 sitemap URLs point at another host or scheme
fix.evidence: In /sitemap.xml: news.cgtn.com (3832), newsaf.cgtn.com (254), newseu.cgtn.com (201) and 1 more. The sitemap should list only URLs on https://www.cgtn.com.
fix.fix: Regenerate the sitemap with the production https host.

fix.title: HSTS is not sent
fix.evidence: strict-transport-security was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed. A first visit over http can be intercepted.

fix.title: 41 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /, /subscribe/rss.html, /subscribe/newsletter.html, /newspal and 16 more. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: 317 images have no alt attribute
fix.fix: Describe informative images. Give decorative ones alt="".

fix.title: Links must have discernible text
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 135 elements on /, /subscribe/rss.html, /subscribe/newsletter.html, for example .bar-logo[href$="www.cgtn.com"][data-action="Nav_Click"] and a[href$="newspal"]. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Give each link text, or an aria-label when it only holds an icon.

fix.title: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 82 elements on /, /subscribe/rss.html, for example li:nth-child(1) > a[href$="privacy"][target="_self"] and li:nth-child(2) > a[target="_self"] > span. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Darken the text or lighten the background until normal text reaches 4.5:1 and large text 3:1.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
The start page declares its language
The largest element paints in 1.1 s
Every page has a meta description
